rulings.ruling: Ruling: model error; model value dropped from the fixture. i5695 p. 5, Residential Clean Energy Credit Limit Worksheet—Line 14: "Enter the total of the following credit(s)/adjustment(s) if you are taking the credit(s)/adjustment(s) on your 2025 income tax return: ... + Energy efficient home improvement credit, Form 5695, line 32 ... + Child tax credit or credit for other dependents, Form 1040, 1040-SR, or 1040-NR, line 19* ...". The prompt (.classm/classm.f5695.16.deepseek.prompt.txt) gives Form 1040 line 18 $7,955.00, Schedule 3 line 5b (Form 5695 line 32) $600.00, Schedule 3 line 3 $0.00, Schedule 8812 line 12 $0.00 (no child tax credit or credit for other dependents; Credit Limit Worksheet B not completed, Worksheet B line 14 $0.00) and Credit Limit Worksheet A line 3 $7,355.00. The model's work, "Limit worksheet: 7,955 - (600 + 7,355) = 0.00", subtracts Credit Limit Worksheet A line 3 as if it were the child tax credit, the round-1 error of cases 5, 6 and 9; the credit taken on Form 1040 line 19 is $0.00. Worksheet line 3 is $7,955.00 less $600.00 = $7,355.00, the project's value. Unrelated to BUG-0196 (remedy wording only).

The prompt (.classm/classm.f5695.5.deepseek.prompt.txt) gives Form 1040 line 18 $11,255.00, Schedule 3 line 5b (Form 5695 line 32) $1,200.00, Schedule 3 lines 1 to 4 $0.00, Schedule 8812 line 12 $0.00 (no child tax credit or credit for other dependents; Credit Limit Worksheet B not completed) and Credit Limit Worksheet A line 3 $10,055.00. The model's work, "11255 - (1200 + 10055) = 0", subtracts Credit Limit Worksheet A line 3 as if it were the child tax credit; the credit taken on Form 1040 line 19 is $0.00 (Schedule 8812 line 14 is the smaller of line 12, $0.00, and line 13). Worksheet line 3 is $11,255.00 less $1,200.00 = $10,055.00, the project's value. The worksheet's line 2 (including Schedule 3 line 3, $0.00 here) is otherwise the project's.
